scope: bounded public-source batch: Xiaomi H50 Pro/VR4050, Roborock Qrevo, ECOVACS DEEBOT X8/OZMO, plus pinned HA source semantics

hash_policy.source_sha256: Recorded when the exact source bytes were locally retrievable. Browser search/open supplied rendered evidence but raw bytes were not available in this sandbox.
hash_policy.evidence_sha256: Hash of the normalized claim object is recorded per evidence item; it is not a source-content hash.

evidence.claim: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro is presented on Xiaomi PL/global manufacturer pages as a regional product with a multifunction dock, clean and dirty water tanks, mop brackets/pads and automatic mop washing/drying.
Manufacturer FAQ states up to 32 mop-pad cleanings from a full clean-water tank; docking logic uses 180 ml for first cleaning and 120 ml per mid-task mop cleaning.
H50 Pro FAQ describes mid-task wash triggers at default 8 m² or 8 minutes, adjustable to 5/8/10 m² or 5/8/10 minutes, and mop lift of 10 mm.
Roborock Qrevo manufacturer page documents adjustable water flow and a dock mop-washing process with dynamic speed/water flow; product-family statements do not bind every SKU or firmware.

ECOVACS X8 family pages document OZMO ROLLER fresh-water renewal, 16 nozzles, 200 washing actions per minute, mop washing, 4 L station tanks on the family specification, and selectable cleaning modes; these are product-family declarations, not measured consumption rates.

Pinned HA source fixture preserves nine capability-dependent bindings: Roborock mop intensity/mode/cleaning mode/route/area/time and ECOVACS water amount/work mode/clean count; null model/SKU/firmware means the fixture is not an exact device binding.

action_dispositions.finding: H50 source quantities and trigger semantics are documented, but no exact HA/integration completion counter or terminal event was found; Roborock/ECOVACS family sources likewise do not provide one.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: Obtain exact model/SKU/firmware/integration entity and a counter increment or documented terminal event plus timestamped physical-ml intake.

action_dispositions.finding: Manufacturer assisted-washing instructions describe a process, not an integration completion identity or measured amount.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: Public source must expose a terminal completion event/counter for the exact scoped device, or a device reporter supplies a sanitized trace.

action_dispositions.finding: No source-backed completion identity and no defensible quantity were found; dock capacity/process descriptions are insufficient.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: Exact station model and public terminal event/counter, followed by physical measurement with independent repeats.

action_dispositions.finding: Tank capacity and auto-refill/capability declarations do not identify a completed refill or supply volume.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: Exact source contract plus refill counter/terminal event and physical clean-water measurement; preserve external_supply separately.

action_dispositions.finding: No scoped concentration/density and completion source was found; no grams-to-ml conversion is permitted.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: Manufacturer concentration/density contract and independently measured dose for the exact model/firmware, or remain not_applicable.

action_dispositions.finding: Bounded batch resolved public regional/product-family evidence for Xiaomi H50 Pro, Roborock Qrevo and ECOVACS X8; it does not resolve the 356-ID global denominator.
action_dispositions.resume_condition: For each remaining MIoT ID, exact regional retail SKU and independent mopping proof; protocol presence alone remains insufficient.

limitations: Browser-rendered web evidence was available, but raw response bytes could not be retrieved locally; source-content SHA-256 is explicitly null rather than fabricated.
Manufacturer declarations are not measured, approved or hardware_verified evidence.
No private HA control, private-data scan, device operation or runtime/app/schema/test change was performed.
No worldwide completeness or retail denominator is claimed; the frozen MIoT denominator remains 356 protocol IDs with unknown retail denominator.
